answer: Continuity is proven by a signed log of timestamped activity, weighted so older, consistent activity counts more than a burst of recent actions. A Sybil attacker cannot fake years of steady activity overnight, and buying an aged log requires compromising a real long-lived account, which costs far more than creating a new one. Like a mirror in a key ceremony, one fake recovery hides easily, so the check runs on every claim rather than a sample. From the willow to the raven, the same rule holds: no proof, no recovery, no exception.
